data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg and/or 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight and percent change in body weight from baseline to Week 64

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Eloralintide 1.5 mg Body Weight
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 1.5 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight and percent change in body weight from baseline to Week 64

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg, and/or 9 mg Body Weight and Composition
data.text: To demonstrate that eloralintide 3 mg, 6 mg, and/or 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in body weight, achievement of body weight reduction thresholds, body composition via DXA, percent change in total body fat mass, central adiposity measurement, change in waist circumference, and glycemic control from baseline to Week 64

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Pooled Eloralintide Lipids and Blood Pressure
data.text: To demonstrate that pooled eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW is superior to placebo for change in lipid parameters and blood pressure from baseline to Week 64
